parameters.jsCode: const cfg=$('Allowed Source').item.json; const MAX_CACHE_CHARS=200000; function stableCanonical(v){ if(Array.isArray(v)) return '['+v.map(stableCanonical).join(',')+']'; if(v&&typeof v==='object'){ return '{'+Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>JSON.stringify(k)+':'+stableCanonical(v[k])).join(',')+'}'; } return JSON.stringify(v); } const canonical=stableCanonical($json); if(canonical.length>MAX_CACHE_CHARS) throw new Error('SOURCE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_SAFE_CHANGE_DETECTION'); let h1=2166136261,h2=5381; for(let i=0;i<canonical.length;i++){const c=canonical.charCodeAt(i);h1^=c;h1=Math.imul(h1,16777619);h2=((h2<<5)+h2)^c;} const content_fingerprint=`diag-v1-${canonical.length}-${(h1>>>0).toString(16)}-${(h2>>>0).toString(16)}`; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.watcher_cache=store.watcher_cache||{}; const previous=store.watcher_cache[cfg.subject_id]; const change_state=previous===undefined?'NEW':(previous.canonical===canonical?'UNCHANGED':'CHANGED'); store.watcher_cache[cfg.subject_id]={canonical,content_fingerprint}; const observation_id=`obs-${cfg.subject_id}-${$execution.id}-${content_fingerprint}`; return [{json:{observation_id,subject_id:cfg.subject_id,source_url:cfg.url,observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),access_method:'GET',evidence_kind:'real',claim_kind:'fact',state:'observed',limitation:cfg.limitation,correlation_id:$execution.id,content_fingerprint,change_state,value:$json,watcher_cache_only:true}}];
